Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:100787

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 15298 of 2024
Applicant :- Smt Shushila
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Garun Pal Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rohit Shukla
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for informant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

2. This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.57 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Farah, District- Mathura, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and she has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is mother-in-law of deceased.
The marriage of deceased with son of applicant has taken place on 23.06.2023.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons, including applicant.
No specific role has been assigned to the applicant.

sentences.text: It was further submitted that before her marriage, the deceased was having affair with some other boy but that engagement had been broken and, thereafter, deceased was hurriedly married with applicant within a period of three days.
The deceased was upset with her marriage with the applicant and she has committed suicide due to that reason.
In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is a lady and she is languishing in jail since 27.02.2024, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.

5. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for informant have opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has suffered death due to hanging within a period of one year of her marriage and there are allegations that she was being harassed by the accused persons on account of dowry.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
7. The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Smt Shushila involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.

iii.
The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which she is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which she is suspected.

9. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
10.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 3.6.2024//SP/-
